{{Top|leg}}
The '''Alien Quarters''' were specific areas within the [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceports]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Gand (planet)/Legends|Gand]]. Non-Gands were very rarely ever allowed to visit Gand, and usually they were allowed no closer than one of the [[Orbit/Legends|orbiting]] [[Space station/Legends|space stations]]. On the extremely rare occasion that offworlders were allowed to Gand's surface, they were restricted to staying within the Alien Quarters.<ref name="EGTAS">[[The Essential Guide to Alien Species (real-world book)|''The Essential Guide to Alien Species'']]</ref>
